tmp:2152: setirat ha-petach — demolishing the doorway (from the elders-of-Athens riddle): the counsel of tearing down the medameh/imagination, identified with impurity, so one can enter the gate of holy intellect
tmp:2153: Ayin-Bet Resh-Yod-Vav (72 + 216) — gematria pair of divine names (Chesed 72 / Gevurah 216) whose sum equals ibur (288, 'grain/pregnancy') in the Rabbi Yonah rain story
tmp:2154: yare'ach — the moon as celestial body/symbol, called 'servant' (sihara) in the Zohar, ruling over the four elements beneath its sphere
tmp:2155: the evil character traits (middot ra'ot) deriving from the four physical elements, termed 'servants' because the elements lie beneath the lunar sphere — nullified in 'out of the house of bondage'
tmp:2157: kefirot — heresies/denials of God, defined as an aspect of idolatry (avodah zarah)
tmp:2159: shemirat ha-mo'ed — the act of guarding/honoring the festivals, whose neglect equals idol worship (Rashi on the juxtaposition of idolatry and festivals)
tmp:2160: avodah tamah — 'complete/unblemished divine service,' the Temple-service term applied to festival observance as the opposite of idolatry
tmp:2161: shishim (sixty) — the number sixty as the measure of nullification of forbidden food (bittul be-shishim), symbolizing the circle (igula), the letter samekh, the Throne of Glory, and 'sixty queens'
tmp:2162: the practice of speaking words of Torah and prayer until the body is nullified — speech-devotion uniting body with holy speech ('they shall be one flesh')
tmp:2163: the state of bodily self-nullification (bittul) attained through Torah and prayer speech — the body becoming null and naught, one with the word
tmp:2164: boshet — shame/bashfulness as a spiritual quality, root of holy boldness, identified with Eden ('the shame-faced goes to the Garden of Eden')
tmp:2166: the or ha-ganuz — the hidden primordial light stored away for the righteous in the future, the 49 lights, 'Eden which no eye has seen'
tmp:2168: the 'od sheli' — the 'yet/more' one finds within oneself (from 'azamrah l'Elokai be-odi'), the residual good point enabling one to sing to God
tmp:2169: the verse 'od me'at ve-ein rasha' (Ps 37:10) — 'yet a little and the wicked is no more,' judging oneself favorably by the small good point that renders one no longer wicked
tmp:2170: zivchei Elohim — 'the sacrifices of God' (Ps 51:19), interpreted as the olah burnt-offering equated with a broken spirit (ruach nishbarah)
tmp:2171: olah (ascent) of the two Houses — 'Mi with Zot ascends': the rising together of Binah (upper house, 'Mi') and Malkhut (lower house, 'Zot')
tmp:2172: the ascent/rectification of speech (dibbur, called 'foot/regel') via Shabbat — 'if you restrain your foot on Shabbat,' repairing speech damaged by the serpent's contamination
tmp:2173: the agency of 'these lights' (the aforementioned orot) — through which one ascends to delight in Shabbat, riding 'the high places of the earth' (Avraham and Yitzchak, the arms of the world)
tmp:2174: the state of ascending and delighting in oneg Shabbat — Shabbat-delight attained via the lights and the patriarchs ('az titanag al Hashem')
tmp:2175: the elevation of all fallen sparks via the eleven spices of the ketoret (incense) — raising sparks from among the idolaters through faithful commerce ('yod'ei teru'ah' as joining)
tmp:2176: the divine name combination El-Havayah (E-l + YHVH) — signifying alma de-atei, the World to Come, drawn into this world
tmp:2177: dibbur shel Shabbat — the speech of Shabbat ('ve-daber davar'), the World-to-Come speech that must be drawn into and complete weekday speech
tmp:2178: olam-shanah-nefesh — the Sefer Yetzirah triad World/Year/Soul, the three statures (komot) that receive vitality from the mitzvot
tmp:2179: osek be-dinei mamonot — engagement in monetary law/judgments, equated with the plain sense of Torah and honest commerce (the 'sleep' aspect of Rosh Hashanah)
tmp:2180: the act of speaking with the Rebbe/master — the disciple's boldness-enabled conversation with his teacher, the measure of closeness to him
tmp:2181: the state of doing and laboring much in divine service — abundant active worship, itself dependent on holy boldness (azut dikdushah)
tmp:2183: histaklut be-vitachon — the gaze of trust: looking with one's eyes to God alone in bitachon ('the eyes of all look to You'), which fashions a vessel of boundary and time for the divine flow
tmp:2184: the making of wings of holiness (kanfei dikdushah) — forming the six holy wings/handbreadths of the brit (circumcision-covenant), as in the six-winged seraphim
tmp:2185: the act of taking speech from da'at (knowledge/awareness) — drawing the word from the mind so it contains the good that makes it heard and accepted
tmp:2186: the act of putting the good into speech — infusing dibbur with tov so that it is heard and accepted ('the good — all desire it')
tmp:2187: the transformative act of making tzedek into tzedakah — adding the heh of five chasadim via charity, elevating fallen Malkhut from 'her feet descend to death'
tmp:2188: iza — the 'goat' of Rav Ashi's sea-goat (Bavli aggadah), read as oz (might/strength), i.e., fear of God, 'the glory of their strength'
tmp:2189: azut de-sitra achra — brazenness of the Other Side, the profane bodily impudence (azut ha-guf) opposed to holy boldness
tmp:2190: one's own divine service ('that he does and labors much for God') — the personal avodah about which one must boldly speak with the Rebbe
tmp:2191: azut le-daber im ha-rav — the specific boldness to speak freely with one's Rebbe/teacher about all one's needs without shame, the measure of closeness
tmp:2192: the verse 'im esak shamayim sham atah' (Ps 139:8) — 'if I ascend to heaven, You are there,' signifying ayil (entering), expertise in ratzo (running upward) in teshuvah
tmp:2193: the phrase 'Ani le-dodi' (Song 6:3) — 'I am my beloved's,' read as the aspect of ayil (entering/ascending), the baki be-ratzo of repentance
tmp:2194: eina chad de-rachamei — the Idra's 'one eye of mercy' of the future time (the single eyeball), the all-good Ein Sof gaze of 'wholly good and beneficent'
tmp:2195: ir Elokeinu — 'the city of our God' (Ps 48), the aspect of 'house' to which prayer is elevated from mountain and field, revealing God's kingship to the nations
tmp:2196: the phrase 'ir ve-kadish min shemaya nachit' (Daniel 4:10) — 'a wakeful holy one descended from heaven,' whose acronym spells Shimon, alluding to the tanna Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai
